data.long_meaning: The name Dabang is derived from the Marathi language, which translates to 'fearless' or 'intrepid'. Linguistically it belongs to the Marathi tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Dabang usually hope their child will grow to embody fearless, intrepid and live with faith, good character and purpose.
